name: The Steel Orphan (CR 25)
body:
The Steel Orphan CR 25

XP 1,638,400
Human bloodrager 10/dragon disciple 10 (dragon harbinger)/champion 10
LN Medium humanoid (human)
Init +14, amazing initiative; Senses blindsense 60 ft., darkvision 10 ft., low-light vision; Perception +28

DEFENSE

AC 38, touch 20, flat—footed 33 (+9 armor, +5 deflection, +4 Dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural, +6 shield); +4 natural while bloodraging, +4 deflection vs. attacks of opportunity provoked by moving through or out of a threatened area or by casting a spell while bloodraging (magic boots)
Hp 354 (10d10+10d12+180+50)
Fort +26, Ref +15, Will +20; +6 Will vs. frightful presence (magic shield), +2 Will when in a bloodrage, +2 vs. spells he or an ally casts (blood sanctuary), +2 Ref vs. effects outside his square (magic shield), +1 trait vs. fear and effect caused by dragons (Draconic Lineage); SR 17 (magic armor)
Defensive Abilities force of will, mythic saves, hard to kill, immortal, improved uncanny dodge, recuperation, to the death, uncanny dodge, unstoppable; DR 2—; Immune acid, paralysis, sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 80 ft., fast movement, impossible speed
Melee +5 dancing dragon bane longsword +37/+32/+27/+22, +39/+34/+29/+24 (1d8+15, +2d6 vs. dragons, 19—20)
Ranged +1 composite shortbow +25/+11/+6 (1d6+6/x3)
Special Attacks bite +37 (1d6+18), bloodrage 53 rounds/day, breath weapon 4/day (60 ft. line, 20d6 acid damage, DC 27), 2 claws +39 (1d8+12, +1d6 acid, magic), flash of rage, fleet charge, legendary champion, mythic power 23/day, mythic presence, mythic rage, shatter spells, surge +1d12, sweeping strike, tail +35 (1d6+18 +1d6 acid), tear apart, titan’s rage, 2 wing buffets +35 (1d4+6 +1d4 acid)
Spell—Like Abilities (CL 20th, concentration +26)

2/day—form of the dragon II (steel dragon only)

Bloodrager Spells Known (CL 7th, concentration +13)

3rd Level (2/day)—draconic reservoir, tail strike
2nd Level (2/day)—acid arrow, blood armor, pouncing fury, resist energyb, sonic scream (DC 18)
1st Level (3/day)—break, cause fear (DC 17), mage armor, magic weapon, shieldB, true strike

Bloodline Draconic (steel)

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 19, Con 24, Int 22, Wis 21, Cha 23
Base Atk +20; CMB +30; CMD 44
Traits Draconic Destiny, Draconic Lineage
Feats Blind—Fight*, Cleave*, Dodge, Draconic ManifestationM* (9 rounds/day), Draconic Tail, Draconic Wing Buffet, Eschew Materials*, Extra RageM, Great Fortitude*, Iron Will, Multiattack, Power Attack*, Raging Vitality, Recovered Rage, ToughnessM*, Weapon FocusM (longsword), Weapon FocusM (claws)
Skills Acrobatics +17, Climb +23, Escape Artist +27, Fly +27, Intimidate +29, Knowledge (arcana) +29, Perception +28, Survival +28
Languages Auran, Common, Dwarven, Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Halfling
SQ blood casting, blood of dragons, draconic heritage, dragon wings (90 ft., good), dragon form, legendary hero, mythic sustenance
Gear amulet of mighty fists +5 (100,000 gp), belt of physical perfection +6 (144,000 gp), bloodrager’s kit (9 gp), boots of swift fury (7,500 gp), cloak of quick reflexesma +5/+6 (37,500 gp), headband of mental superiority +6 (144,000 gp), +5 dancing dragon bane longsword (200,315 gp), ring of protection +5 (50,000 gp), +5 poisoningmm spell resistance 17 dragonhidedsh armor (100,270 gp), scaled sashdsh (black) (73,000 gp), +1 composite shortbow (3,075 gp) with 20 arrows (1 gp), wyrmslayer’s shieldue (20,170 gp), 150 gp
